scene: The clanking sorting robot whirs happily and dispenses a glowing parcel.
picture: Flat side view. Along the floor, on the far left, a striped cat sleeps in a cardboard box. Left of centre stands the player, facing right. Centre, the wheeled sorting robot extends an arm holding a glowing parcel. Right, an inclined conveyor belt leads up toward an overhead hatch.
shown: a glowing blue parcel held in the sorting robot's mechanical arm at centre
a rumbling rubber luggage conveyor belt sloping up high on the right
a striped tabby cat sleeping inside an open cardboard box on the far left
